At another bank's ATM in Kenya, Kaskazi charges **KES 35 for each cash withdrawal**. Another bank or ATM owner may charge its own fee for using its machine, separate from Kaskazi Bank's fee. The ATM must show you that fee on screen before you go ahead, so you can cancel if you don't want to pay it.

Kaskazi ATMs are free for withdrawals.

asks.answer:
The least you can pay this month is **KES 1,000**. The minimum is the higher of 5% of your statement balance, or KES 1,000. On a balance of KES 12,000, 5% is only KES 600, so the KES 1,000 floor applies.

Paying only the minimum avoids the late payment fee, but it is the most expensive way to repay. If you can, pay more than KES 1,000, or the full balance.

asks.question: I added a new recipient this morning and the app is refusing to send them 80k. why??
asks.answer:
The app is applying the new-recipient limit. For the first 24 hours after you add someone, you can send them up to KES 50,000 in total. After 24 hours, your normal limits apply.

If you need to send the full amount today, for example a deposit on a house, visit a branch with your ID. Otherwise, you can send the rest once the 24 hours have passed since you added the recipient.
